# braintrust_group (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Braintrust group by name and optional organization ID. Useful for referencing built-in groups (`Owners`, `Engineers`, `Viewers`, `All AI Provider Access`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up the built-in Engineers group
data "braintrust_group" "engineers" {
  name = "Engineers"
}

output "engineers_group_id" {
  value = data.braintrust_group.engineers.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the group to look up.

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) Organization the group belongs to. Set this when the credential can access multiple organizations.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of group creation.
- `deleted_at` (String) Date of group deletion, or null if the group is still active.
- `description` (String) Textual description of the group.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the group (UUID).
- `member_groups` (Set of String) IDs of groups this group inherits from.
- `member_users` (Set of String) IDs of users in this group.
- `user_id` (String) Identifies the user who created the group.
